description: ADVANCED OUTCOME-RECORDING TOOL. Record the observed result for an existing ATL Decision when execution happened outside ATL or needs explicit feedback. Use the exact decision_reference and outcome_correlation_token returned by ATL; do not invent them. This tool does not execute a provider/tool and does not replace atl_execute. For normal ATL-owned task completion, prefer atl_complete_task, which records Outcome automatically.

attempt_outcomes.description: Observed results for individual provider execution attempts.

cancelled.description: Whether execution was cancelled before completion.

correlation_id.description: Correlation identifier associated with the original ATL Decision. Reuse the original value when required by the schema.

decision_reference.description: Exact Decision reference returned by ATL. Copy it from atl_decide or next_step; never invent or modify it.

error_code.description: Provider error code observed during execution.

failure_type.description: Category of the observed execution failure.

final_provider_id.description: Provider that actually completed execution, if it changed.

http_status.description: HTTP status returned by the provider, when applicable.

observed_cost.description: Observed execution cost when known; omit when unavailable unless required by the schema.

observed_latency_ms.description: Observed provider execution latency in milliseconds.

outcome_correlation_token.description: Exact Outcome correlation token returned with the ATL Decision. Copy it unchanged; never invent or modify it.

outcome_status.description: Observed outcome status for the referenced Decision/execution, such as success or failure, using the schema's allowed value when constrained.

provider_id.description: Provider identifier associated with the observed execution. Do not use this field to override ATL's selected provider.

request_id.description: Request identifier associated with the original ATL Decision. Reuse the original value when required by the schema.

session_id.description: MCP session ID returned by initialize.

name: atl_outcome
